whoItsFor: Developers who use Claude Code and want multi-agent orchestration without learning its internals. Teams that want coordinated agent workflows (the project is 'Teams-first') can also use it.
useCases: Build a feature end to end from one prompt with /autopilot
Run parallel agent teams to fix or refactor code with /team
Get a second-model code review by launching Codex tmux workers with omc team

requirements.os: Linux required only for named autopilot stage profiles (uses flock); README does not state an OS for the rest
requirements.runtime: Claude Code; npm for the CLI install; tmux for omc team workers
